title: Create: Airborne Industry
description: Build factories, automate production, and create flying machines with Create Aeronautics.
body:
My modpack is designed for a smooth and enjoyable experience with friends, built around Create and the Create Aeronautics addon. The main focus is on automation, engineering systems, and constructing complex flying machines.

The pack also includes additional Create addons that expand transportation, production, and logistics capabilities. Everything is carefully assembled with an emphasis on stability, mod compatibility, and smooth gameplay without unnecessary clutter. It’s suitable both for cooperative survival and for experimenting with mechanics and large-scale engineering projects.
